candidates.formal_type:
∀ (k : Type u_1) (Q : Type u_2) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [inst_1 : Quiver.{u_3, u_2} Q] [inst_2 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q]
  [inst_3 : Fintype.{u_2} Q],
  Eq.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)}
    (Algebra.adjoin.{u_1, max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} k
      (Union.union.{max (max u_1 u_2) u_3}
        (setOf.{max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} fun x =>
          Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun i =>
            Eq.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)} x (Etingof.Problem2_8_6.Book.vertexIdem.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k Q i))
        (setOf.{max (max u_1 u_2) u_3} fun x =>
          Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun i =>
            Exists.{u_2 + 1} fun j =>
              Exists.{u_3 + 1} fun e =>
                Eq.{max (max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)} x
                  (Etingof.Problem2_8_6.Book.arrowGen.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k Q e))))
    Top.top.{max (max u_1 u_2) u_3}
